products.name: EX Emerald Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs. The Farfetch'd secret rare that Elite Fourum's rarity guide puts on top of a box is not simulated (it is in no pack).

products.name: EX Collector's Tin [Kyogre ex]
products.note: Four packs in the real tin, two Emerald and two Crystal Guardians (pkmn.gg's np-37 to np-39 'EX Collector's Tins', October 2006; the pack mix is Bulbapedia's search excerpt only, so low-medium confidence), with the cosmos holo ex promo. Tin not simulated. TCGplayer lists no tin: priced from its packs at the Emerald pack price.
